d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne bihar ke daure ke dauran nitish setu samet rajy ko kaee vikas pariyojnaon ki saugat di, is avsar par unhonne garib kalyan ke sankalp ko dohrate hue kangres par nishana sadha. idhar, mukhyamantri ko prakash parv aur luguburu dhoromgarh rajkiy mahotsav men shamil hone ka aamantran diya gaya. vahin, kendriy mantri annapurna devi giridih men projekt navankur ke tahat aayojit karyakram men shamil hueen, jahan mahilaon ke bich poshan kit ka vitran kiya gaya. dusri or, giridih men bhajpa pradesh padadhikariyon ki baithak aayojit huee, jismen pradesh adhyaksh aadity…
